messages:
nina.bradley: heads-up: noticed several broken anchors and image 404s in canary after the assets reorg. quick grep found /images/ and /assets/ paths still referenced in multiple runbooks.
dev-docs-bot: automated-scan: multiple 404s detected (scan id 90001) - sample paths: /images/diag/batch.png, /assets/diagrams/paging-flow.png
aaron.k: i can take a pass on the small rehosts + md link updates. plan: run repo grep, copy assets into /static/diagrams where missing, update markdown links, open a series of tiny PRs against canary for preview. will tag reviewers.
maria.nguyen: thanks Aaron. please also add a short docs-ci grep to flag /images/ or /assets/ occurrences in markdown during the sprint. i'll add this sweep to tomorrow's docs-sprint board and note translations may need backport.
aaron.k: ack. i'll run `scripts/preview --canary` for each PR and include changelog notes. posting the first PR shortly.
dev-docs-bot: re-scan scheduled after PRs (scan id 90002)
nina.bradley: appreciate it. tiny ask: when you update alt text please prefer descriptive alt + one-line caption for searchability.
aaron.k: noted. starting the sweep now.
